title: Three movements: listen, reflect, return
intro: A simple framework keeps the work warm without letting it become vague.

sections.heading: Listen
sections.body: We make room for the story beneath the request.

sections.heading: Reflect
sections.body: We explore symbols, patterns, feelings, and possibilities together.

sections.heading: Return
sections.body: We close with a practical question, boundary, ritual, or next step.
